questions.question: To what mountain fortress does Théoden take his people?
questions.note: Its walls have never been breached. Until now.

questions.question: About how many Uruk-hai march on Helm's Deep?
questions.note: Aragorn: 'An army bred for a single purpose: to destroy the world of Men.'

questions.question: In the film, who arrives to fight alongside Rohan at Helm's Deep?
questions.note: A film addition. They march in to honor the old alliance.

questions.question: Which Elf leads the Elves at Helm's Deep and dies there?
questions.note: He met the Fellowship at the borders of Lothlórien.

questions.question: What do Legolas and Gimli keep count of during the battle?
questions.note: It becomes a running joke into the next film.

questions.question: How do the Uruk-hai breach the Deeping Wall?
questions.answer: With an explosive in the culvert
choices: With an explosive in the culvert
questions.note: Saruman's blasting fire, lit by a runner with a torch.

questions.question: Who says 'Look to my coming at first light on the fifth day'?
questions.note: He adds: at dawn, look to the east.

questions.question: Who rides in with Gandalf at dawn to save Helm's Deep?
questions.note: They charge down the slope with the sun behind them.

questions.question: What horse finds Aragorn after he falls from a cliff fighting Wargs?
questions.note: Théodred's horse. Aragorn had calmed him in Edoras.

questions.question: Where are the women and children sheltered during the battle?
questions.answer: In the caves behind the fortress
choices: In the caves behind the fortress
